chapter_note: The opening unit (¶1–9) is a compact cosmogonic survey in an impersonal, system-internal register (Separation of the two principles; attack of Darkness; First Man; Living Spirit’s construction; Third Ambassador; final conflagration and binding). From ¶10 onward the chapter shifts to a justificatory/protreptic frame (Mani’s books, exhortations to write, institutional categories, and comparative apostle-history), with strong editorial fatigue and institutional drift; this later material is not part of the oldest correspondential-teaching substrate.

Canonical-source self-reference: listing Mani’s named books (‘Great Gospel’, ‘Treasury’, etc.) is a compilation/authorizing frame, not the older substrate.
Authorizing rhetoric about ‘writer/teacher of truth’ and ‘I have revealed’ belongs to a justificatory frame for the corpus, not impersonal cosmology.
Introduces the ‘first great lesson’ schema tied to Mani’s didactic program and includes autobiographical-sounding ‘my pains / my afflictions’; not a self-contained cosmic mapping sequence.
Editorial seam (flagged): pivot to institutional categories (‘teachers’, ‘leaders’, ‘elect’, ‘catechumens’) and exhortation to record unwritten material—cosmos → community administration.
Direct imperative address (‘You must remember… write… gather…’)—application voice, not substrate exposition.
Community stratification (‘elect’, ‘suckling babes’, sects/heresies) and pedagogical accommodation—church/institutional discourse.
Transmission/authority discussion (‘apostles’, ‘earliest fathers’, ‘church’, ‘book’) continues the prologue’s justificatory frame rather than cosmological mechanics.
Explicit Jesus-history in ‘land of the west’ with disciples writing parables/signs—material entering via Christian tradition/NT narrative vector.
Hagiographic-historical comparison (Zarathustra; disciples writing what is ‘read today’). Though Iranian, it functions as prologue frame about textual corruption, not cosmic mapping.
Buddha comparison (churches; disciples writing scriptures) serves the same justificatory frame, not substrate cosmology.
Argument about churches passing away due to not writing books—meta-textual institutional framing, not system-internal teaching.
Exhortation with application aim (‘you write after me… so that… leads you not astray’) and ‘commandments’ language—later pastoral layer.
Direct imperatives (‘remember! And write…’)—protreptic application voice.
Continues the exhortatory payoff of writing (‘they shall give benefit…’) within the same pastoral prologue function.
